induction t with head tail using Finset.induction_on with
| [] => 
  trivial
| _ => 
  let h := (Finset.singleton_head head).symm
  have : (⋃ i ∈ h, s i).ncard ≤ ∑ i ∈ h, (s i).ncard := by
    rw [h]
    exact ncard_le_sum (s head)
  rw [Finset.union_singleton] at this
  rw [Finset.sum_singleton] at this
  constructor
  · exact this
  · apply ncard_le_sum
    intro i
    exact (s i).ncard ≤ (s i).ncard
